answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow: a new identity locks a 50-POA bond until its behavior fingerprint matures. The network logs timing, counterparties and task mix into a relic no one can fake overnight; only a fingerprint consistent for 20 epochs unlocks it, in full at the zenith of trust. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA and needs 20 epochs each, far above the 12,000-POA pool; an honest agent pays once, like a grove keeping its harvest.
